page_title: MON 0-1 GEN | Monza v Genoa 24/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+8' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
90+8' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Monza can continue in their attacking effort.
90+6' Pablo Mari (Monza) sees a yellow card from Maurizio Mariani after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
90+5' Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
90+4' Looks like Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
90+3' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) picks up a yellow card.
90+1' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
86' The corner is swung in but Monza can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

86' Samuele Vignato (Monza) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The linesman points to the corner flag, Monza are going to take it.
85' Substitution. Pedro Pereira (Monza) in, Samuele Birindelli out.
84' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Monza comes to nothing.

84' Great solo effort by Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) as he beats two defenders before firing in a drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper is ready and makes an amazing save. The ball is out of play and Monza manage to earn a corner.
82' Aaron Martin (Genoa) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

78' That was absolutely fantastic! Gianluca Caprari (Monza) tries his luck with a hammer shot from long range, but his effort only rattles the right post! Here is an example of luck not being on your side.
75' Alessandro Nesta has decided to substitute Dany Mota and he is replaced by Samuele Vignato (Monza).
75' It's time for a substitution. Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) comes on in place of Armando Izzo.
74' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
73' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
72' Armando Izzo (Monza) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box.
72' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
72' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out of play. Monza are awarded a corner kick.
68' Alberto Gilardino has decided to make a change. Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) replaces Andrea Pinamonti.
66' A dangerous towering header by Pablo Mari (Monza) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
66' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) will take a corner kick.
62' Daniel Maldini goes off the pitch and Gianluca Caprari (Monza) comes on.
62' The substitution is prepared. Milan Djuric (Monza) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Andrea Petagna.
62' Substitution. Milan Badelj is replaced by Morten Thorsby (Genoa).
62' Alberto Gilardino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) replacing Vitinha.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) will replace Stefano Sabelli.
59' Koni De Winter (Genoa) argues with the referee and receives a yellow card for dissent.
59' Andrea Petagna (Monza) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the right post.
58' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
57' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
55' The possession of the ball – 61:39.
49' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
48' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle and signals a foul after Aaron Martin (Genoa) brought his opponent down. It's a free kick to Monza, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+8' The end of the first half.

45+7' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Stefano Sabelli sends a superb cross into the box. Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) latches on to it and from near the penalty spot powers a header low inside the left post, leaving Semuel Pizzignacco beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 0:1.
45+4' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Daniel Maldini (Monza) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
45+2' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) takes it short.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
45' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Mattia Bani leaves the pitch to be replaced by Alessandro Vogliacco (Genoa).
44' Mattia Bani (Genoa) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
40' Aaron Martin (Genoa) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
39' Armando Izzo (Monza) is booked for saying more than Maurizio Mariani was willing to tolerate.
39' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle and it's Koni De Winter (Genoa) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
38' Aaron Martin (Genoa) will take the corner.
38' Vitinha (Genoa) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Genoa.
37' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
31' Junior Messias (Genoa) is able to continue to play.
30' Junior Messias (Genoa) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
26' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.

22' Daniel Maldini (Monza) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Pierluigi Gollini tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
21' What an opportunity! Milan Badelj (Genoa) wins the ball from the resulting set piece and unleashes a precise shot from inside the goal area which sails narrowly wide of the left post!
20' Genoa are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
20' Armando Izzo (Monza) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul. Genoa earn a free kick.
18' Junior Messias (Genoa) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post.
13' The resulting set piece from Monza is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

12' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Monza have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
7' Daniel Maldini (Monza) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Monza will take the kick-off.
Maurizio Mariani will officiate today.
